_note: Full VN coverage (63 provinces, all legacy districts) sourced from backend GET /v1/addresses/provinces and /provinces/{id}/districts. district code = GSO district_code (what search_listings districtCode expects). Curated aliases for HCM/HN/DN preserved; others auto-generated from name/shortName. Regenerate by re-running the address-endpoint export when admin data changes.
_structure_note: Vietnam reorganised its admin units on 2025-07-01: the old 3-tier structure (63 provinces → district → ward) was replaced by a new 2-tier one (34 provinces → ward, no districts). This file mixes both: 'provinces' use post-reform 2-digit codes (still 79 for HCMC, 01 for Hà Nội etc.), while 'districts' are LEGACY pre-reform 3-digit codes (e.g. 765=Bình Thạnh) that no longer exist as admin units. Listings in the DB can be stored under either structure (Address.address_type = OLD | NEW); the backend reverse-maps districtId to new ward codes via the address_mapping table on every search. AI agents should keep sending provinceCode + districtId because Vietnamese users still refer to old district names in conversation; the backend handles the bidirectional mapping. New ward codes (5-digit) are NOT in this file yet.
